step_by_step_reasoning: Identified physical whiteboard nodes: Players, On-premises Game Servers, EKS, MSK regional buffer, S3 Delta Lake, and AWS Glue. Established sequential data flows from players through both the API (EKS) and local game servers (OnPremDC) into regional MSK, then written to S3. Glue is kept as a floating node with no visual connections as drawn.

graph.name: Riot Games - HONO over IP Data Ingest System
graph.notes: Whiteboard details ingest architecture for League of Legends, processing 8TB/day at peaks of over 500k events/sec using MSK and S3.

nodes.name: Players

nodes.name: Local Game Servers

nodes.notes: Delta Lake data store written to via Spark streaming.

nodes.name: AWS Glue

edges.notes: Players interact with game APIs hosted in EKS.
Telemetry data is routed from EKS to regional MSK.
Players connect directly to on-prem game servers.
MirrorMaker replicates local data to regional MSK clusters.
Spark jobs streaming data from MSK to S3.
